Location: CHIJMES event plaza

Crowd: The morning briefing just wrapped; are we departing in batches?
Crowd2: Let's hug the left corridor so families have space.
Crowd3: I'll call out if the lane clogs; keep the pace steady.

Location: Chinatown staging lane

Orchestra (over command channel): Police, secure the south staircase at Chinatown and hold a three-meter buffer for inbound groups.
Police: Command wants us ready at the stairway—move the cones into position.
Police2: Copy, I'll take the lead once the first wave arrives.
conversation.20250213-09:40:
Location: Chinatown north corridor near Pagoda Street

Crowd2: Pressure is building from the rear; can someone guide them left?
Crowd3: I'll fan them toward the lantern arch; stay on the rope line.
Crowd5: Keep close—volunteers just opened the side lane.

Location: Trengganu Street checkpoint

Orchestra (over command channel): Police, form a one-way lane on Trengganu Street and walk families through first.
Police: Roger that; I'm staging cones and calling for two volunteers.
Crowd4: Thanks, officer—we'll queue behind the barrier.
Police2: Crowd4, keep your group tight while we open the lane.
conversation.20250213-09:50:
Location: Sago Street central walkway

Crowd: This corridor feels tight; do we head straight or turn off?
Police2: Stay straight for now—shift to the left rail when you see my signal.

Location: Temple Street food row

Orchestra (over command channel): Police, clear the temple-side lane and divert overflow toward Smith Street.
Police: Understood; I'll hold this corner until the next wave passes.
Crowd4: We'll maintain the gap, officer—signal us when to proceed.
conversation.20250213-10:00:
Location: Chinatown central plaza west edge

Crowd: Volunteers want us tighter; is there still room ahead?
Crowd5: I'll ease our row inward; follow the tape line.

Location: Funan Mall

Orchestra (over command channel): Police, open the Temple Street detour and rotate Crowd2's column toward the plaza exit.
Crowd2: Officer, do we pivot to the detour now?
Police: Yes, follow me through the divider and stay two abreast.

Location: South bridge alley

Crowd4: We're holding at the alley mouth—any update?
Police2: Stay put; once the detour flows I'll wave your group through.
conversation.20250213-10:10:
Location: Chinatown east corridor

Crowd: The pace is uneven; can we shift to the right lane?
Crowd2: Good call; follow the family ahead to keep spacing.

Location: Mosque Street buffer

Orchestra (over command channel): Police, release the buffer near Mosque Street and escort Crowd3 toward the plaza exit.
Crowd3: Officer, density is spiking in front of us.
Police: I see it—stay on my right and we'll thin the lane together.
conversation.20250213-10:20:
Location: Smith Street midpoint

Crowd: The signs point left; are we close to the exit?
Crowd3: Almost there—keep inching forward.
Police2: Maintain a single file until you clear the lantern arch.

Location: Chinatown food courtyard

Orchestra (over command channel): Police, cycle Crowd4's queue through the courtyard and merge them behind Police2 once clear.
Crowd4: Should we start moving now?
Police: Yes, stay with me along the barricade.
Crowd5: Copy that; I'll set a gentle pace so no one rushes.
conversation.20250213-10:30:
Location: Temple Street lantern lane

Crowd: We're next to the stage—hold or proceed?
Crowd5: Hold for ten seconds; once the lane clears we'll slip through.

Location: Smith Street crossover

Orchestra (over command channel): Police, escort Crowd2's column across Smith Street and close the back gate afterward.
Crowd2: Ready on your signal, officer.
Police2: Follow my shoulder; I'll block cross-traffic while you pass.

Location: Trengganu Street side aisle

Crowd3: I see an opening to the right.
Crowd4: Let's take it together before it fills.
conversation.20250213-10:40:
Location: Smith Street dispersal bend

Crowd2: The rope line is tight; can we stagger our steps?
Crowd4: I'll call the rhythm—three steps then pause.
Crowd5: Works for me; I'll watch the kids on the edge.

Location: South Bridge Road crossing

Orchestra (over command channel): Police, take Crowd3 across South Bridge Road in two batches and confirm once the crosswalk is clear.
Crowd3: Officer, signal when it's our turn.
Police: Wait for my hand; I'll stop traffic and wave you through.
conversation.20250213-10:50:

Crowd: We're nearing the open plaza—should we speed up?
